items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he had this tune that he and Milt Jackson were playing... In Dizzy’s band he was playing both piano and vibes

ctx.x: I just want to ask you… I want to go back to your playing with Dizzy at Birdland. Tell me that funny story about the tune you named for Dizzy.

Well Dizzy was always a ladies man. I mean Dizzy had a good eye for the ladies, you know because he was always making jokes and everything he could get away with it. I mean he would be talking to whatever lady that happened to come in… a lot of pretty ladies came into Birdland. He came in one time from being on the road and he had this tune that he and Milt Jackson were playing. Milt… whenever the band played at Birdland, Milt greeted me like a long lost brother because at last he could get up from the piano. In…
From that period, you had mentioned that was a formative period for your development working in those clubs. I believe that’s 1951 to 1953?
